fixes.before: ABC reported Trump backing BHP and Rio Tinto over the US copper mine dispute. [[n0418]] Treat political support as an option on project progress. The earnings opportunity depends on workable approvals, disciplined construction and a commercial return, rather than the headline alone.
fixes.after: For copper producers, earnings upside requires viable mine investment and reliable production rather than a metal-price rally alone. Monitor output, realised pricing and project expenditure. A permitting change would help shareholders only if it opened a route to a commercial return; an approval by itself would not settle construction costs, funding or cash conversion.
fixes.reason: Remove the claim that Trump had backed BHP and Rio Tinto, for which pre-midnight availability was not established. Replace the outcome-based thesis with a conditional, company-level EPS test; no new event is asserted.
